title: Comfort Club Member Benefits Bulletin: Member Credit Eligibility on Replacement System Installations
content:
# Member credit on a replacement installation — eligibility

## Retired clause

The following clause is **no longer in force** and has been superseded by the current basis for the member install credit:

> A Comfort Club member receives the tier's install credit on a replacement installation contract, posted once as a member install credit naming the contract-price charge.

## Clauses in force

- The member credit on a Replacement System Installations contract applies only when the customer's Comfort Club agreement is in active status on the contract's signing date.
- A pending, past-due, lapsed or cancelled agreement earns no credit.
- Enrolling or reinstating after signing does not earn the credit retroactively.
- The credit is given once per project.
- The credit is not paid out in cash.
- On a cancelled project the credit is reversed together with the charge it named.
- The credit stacks with the manufacturer rebate and the multi-system discount, all three applying to the contract price independently.

## Basis of judgement

The agreement's status is read from the Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements records as the system holds them, against the signing date recorded on the project. Whether a member credit has already been given is read from the project's ledger.

## Agreement status on the signing date

| Agreement status on the signing date | Credit |
|---|---|
| Active | Earned |
| Pending | Not earned |
| Past due | Not earned |
| Lapsed | Not earned |
| Cancelled | Not earned |
| No agreement on that date; enrolled or reinstated afterwards | Not earned |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical homeowners)

- A hypothetical homeowner whose agreement was active on the signing date and lapsed a month later keeps eligibility, because the test is the status on the signing date.
- A hypothetical homeowner who signed while past due and cured the agreement the following week does not earn the credit.
- A hypothetical project that already carries a member credit does not receive a second one.
